title: Synthesis, structure and luminescent properties of lanthanide fluoroalkoxides

synthesis.procedure: Under evacuated Schlenk conditions excluding air and water, a solution of SmI2(THF)2 (0.351 g, 0.64 mmol) in 10 ml of THF was added to a solution of ROK (prepared from 0.050 g (1.25 mmol) of KH and 0.236 g (1.40 mmol) of ROH) in 10 ml of THF. The mixture was stirred for 5 h. KI was filtered off and the solvent was removed in vacuo. The residue was extracted with diethyl ether (4 × 10 ml). Concentrating and cooling of the extract afforded dark red crystals of 10.

reagents.name: ROK (hexafluoroisopropoxide potassium salt)
reagents.amount: prepared from 0.050 g KH and 0.236 g ROH

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: KI precipitate filtered off; solvent removed by condensation in vacuo; residue extracted with diethyl ether (4 × 10 ml); dark red crystals obtained after concentrating and cooling the extract.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility of 10 was measured; μ_eff = 2.91 μB, consistent with a heterovalent Sm(II)/Sm(III) trinuclear cluster. Photoluminescence was reported for cerium complexes and Eu/Y complex 11, not for 10.
